question: How many times did I listen to Björk?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND a.name = 'Björk'

question: When did I first listen to Show by Ado?

question: Quando ho ascoltato per la prima volta Show di Ado?

question: What is my longest run of consecutive days with at least one Björk play?
reference_sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.local_date AS day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND a.name = 'Björk'), runs AS (SELECT day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM days) SELECT MAX(run_length) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM runs GROUP BY grp)

question: Qual è la mia serie più lunga di giorni consecutivi con almeno un ascolto di Björk?
reference_sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.local_date AS day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND a.name = 'Björk'), runs AS (SELECT day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM days) SELECT MAX(run_length) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM runs GROUP BY grp)

question: What are my top 3 artists by counted plays, including any ties at the cutoff?
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id), positioned AS (SELECT artist, plays, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plays DESC) AS position FROM ranked) SELECT artist, plays FROM positioned WHERE position <= 3 ORDER BY plays DESC, artist ASC

question: Quali sono i miei 3 artisti più ascoltati per ascolti conteggiati, comprese le parità al limite?
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT a.name AS artist, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id), positioned AS (SELECT artist, plays, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plays DESC) AS position FROM ranked) SELECT artist, plays FROM positioned WHERE position <= 3 ORDER BY plays DESC, artist ASC

question: How many counted plays did I have on each known kind of device?
reference_sql: SELECT device_type, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY plays DESC, device_type ASC

question: Quanti ascolti conteggiati ho fatto per ciascun tipo di dispositivo noto?
reference_sql: SELECT device_type, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens WHERE counted = 1 AND device_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY plays DESC, device_type ASC

question: Which track did I play more than once on the same day, and how many times?
reference_sql: SELECT t.title AS track, l.local_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY t.id, l.local_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY l.local_date, track

question: Quale brano ho ascoltato più di una volta nello stesso giorno e quante volte?
reference_sql: SELECT t.title AS track, l.local_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM listens l JOIN tracks t ON t.id = l.track_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY t.id, l.local_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY l.local_date, track

question: How do my counted plays of Ado and Radiohead compare?

question: Come si confrontano i miei ascolti conteggiati di Ado e Radiohead?

question: How many artists did I first play in 2024 and still play in 2025?
reference_sql: WITH artist_years AS (SELECT a.id AS id, MIN(l.local_date) AS first_day, MAX(l.local_date) AS last_day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM artist_years WHERE first_day >= '2024-01-01' AND first_day < '2025-01-01' AND last_day >= '2025-01-01'

question: Quanti artisti ho ascoltato per la prima volta nel 2024 e ascolto ancora nel 2025?
reference_sql: WITH artist_years AS (SELECT a.id AS id, MIN(l.local_date) AS first_day, MAX(l.local_date) AS last_day FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 GROUP BY a.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM artist_years WHERE first_day >= '2024-01-01' AND first_day < '2025-01-01' AND last_day >= '2025-01-01'

question: Quanti giorni sono passati tra il mio primo e il mio ultimo ascolto di Ado?
reference_sql: SELECT CAST(julianday(MAX(l.local_date)) - julianday(MIN(l.local_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days FROM listens l JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = l.track_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = ta.artist_id WHERE l.counted = 1 AND a.name = 'Ado'
